slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: items
slots.about: planned things: id, date, name, tag (a short word, may be blank)

slots.name: picks
slots.about: quick picks offered under a day after its add: id, name, tag

slots.name: day_names
slots.about: seven short day names, Sunday first, in the app's language; the week starts on the phone's first_weekday

slots.name: today_word
slots.about: before today's day name, so today is not told by colour alone

slots.name: nothing_text
slots.about: under a day with nothing planned

slots.name: add_word
slots.about: spoken before the day on its add button while closed

slots.name: close_word
slots.about: spoken before the day on its add button while the picks are open

slots.name: previous_label
slots.about: spoken on the previous week button

slots.name: next_label
slots.about: spoken on the next week button

empty.shows: nothing_text under a day with nothing planned; every day keeps its header

attention.shows: today's header in accent and led by today_word, only on the current week

fallback.shows: the quick picks open under that day; paging the week closes them

labels.add: add_word or close_word and the day

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Days come from first_weekday and a week offset in state, so paging never assumes Monday. A pick lands on the opened day of the shown week. The add_pick guard (adding > 0) has no check that can fail: see mutants.json pick-without-day.
